title: LLM Inference Memory & Graph Runtime: PagedAttention/FlashInfer, Piece-wise CUDA Graph & Persistent Cache Benchmark

workload_assumptions.gpu_node: 4x NVIDIA H200 SXM (564 GB Total HBM3e)

tiers.name: Tier 1: Contiguous Static KV Pre-Allocation (`max_seq_len=32K`) + Eager Python Kernel Launch
tiers.verdict: Anti-Pattern: 75.5% of KV HBM wasted on contiguous over-reservation; 6.4ms/step Python launch tax

tiers.name: Tier 2: PagedAttention (`block_size=16`) in Eager Mode (Eliminates HBM Fragmentation, Keeps CPU Launch Tax)
tiers.verdict: 3.8x higher concurrent batch size, but CPU launch overhead (5.8ms) still accounts for 27% of TPOT

tiers.name: Tier 3: Full-Batch CUDA Graph (1..512 Unbucketed) + Uncached `torch.compile` on Every Pod Boot
tiers.verdict: Fast TPOT (14.9ms), but unbucketed CUDA graphs eat 11 GB HBM/GPU and pod cold-start takes 11.3 minutes!

tiers.name: Tier 4: FlashInfer Cascade Paged KV + Bucketed Piece-wise CUDA Graph + Shared Read-Write Compile Cache
tiers.verdict: Recommended: 96.8% KV HBM utilization, 0.2ms launch tax, 38s pod boot & $0.39/1M tokens (-73.6%)
